name: E4_forest_system
title: System-level evaluation: random-forest inference on a PCM analog CAM with transistor-level bound errors (sky130, PDK mismatch), AIHWKit PCM noise and match-line crosstalk; input remap versus divider supply as drift-compensation node

models.note: tt, 27 C; the E3b subset (nfet_01v8 and nfet_01v8_lvt files identical to the E1 subset, plus pfet_01v8)

circuit.criterion: V_sw,pd = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V (E1-E3c)

branch_types.L6T: lower bound of the 6T2M cell: divider node X drives the pull-down; switching point V_sp = V_sw,pd
branch_types.UINV: upper bound of the 6T2M cell: divider node Y -> INV_S -> pull-down; V_sp = V_Y*, the inverter input at which its output equals V_sw,pd (E3b)
branch_types.LBUF: lower bound with a gain stage: X -> INV_S -> INV_S -> pull-down; V_sp = V_X* = T1^-1(T2^-1(V_sw,pd)) with the instance's own inverters and pull-down

circuit.supplies: each branch type has its own supply V_SL = V_sp,nom + D (lower SL_lo, upper SL_hi)
circuit.data_line: one data line per cell drives both dividers; the input map is defined by the nominal curve of the cell set's lower-bound type: M0(x) = I_0^-1(G(x) D) at V_DS = V_sp,nom(lower), G(x) = g_lo + x (g_hi - g_lo); every bound (lower and upper) is programmed by threshold verify to switch at V_DL = M0(theta)
circuit.programming: G_k = I_div,k(M0(theta)) / (V_SL,nom - V_sp,k), clipped to [0, g_max]; then AIHWKit programming noise
circuit.wildcards: unconstrained bounds are bypassed (never mismatch); their pull-downs stay at gate 0 V (w0 each)

is.role: reference: the same 6T2M cells with ideal per-cell sensing

gs.role: crosstalk suppressed by a gain stage in the lower branch (residual leakage near the bounds modelled)

gi.role: reference: gain-stage cells with ideal per-cell sensing

ml.rule: inverse-time additivity: a row of N cells mismatches if a bound is violated or if sum_k w_k + (2N - n_c) w0 >= 1 + (2N - 1) w0, with w(V) = I_D(V, V_DS = v_mid) / I_D(V_sw, V_DS = v_mid) of the nominal pull-down, w0 = w(0); the sense time t_s(N) is defined as in E3c (nominal pull-down at V_sw, all other gates 0 V)
ml.leakage: shifted-curve model: a matched bound with effective threshold theta_eff and input u inside it leaks like the nominal cell whose bound is theta_eff under the same compensation regime; tables W(theta_eff, u) per branch type, design and regime
ml.calibration_before_freeze: on the E3c data (prior experiment): the rule with v_mid = 1.35 V reproduces the E3c pull-down-only switching-level shifts within 0.26 mV (|delta_l| <= 53 mV) and 2.3 mV (k15d7.5 at t0, delta_l -117 and -96 mV), all 30 false-mismatch flags and 11 of 12 entries of the false-mismatch map (d = 4 LSB, supply: 12 vs 13, sum 1.002); the table node solver reproduces the 30 E3c leaker node voltages within 0.9 uV

pcm_model.source: AIHWKit PCMLikeNoiseModel (IBM/aihwkit master, read 2026-10-12); Nandakumar et al., ICECS 2019, IEEE Xplore 8964852; identical to E0.1/E0.2

replica: a_hat(t) = mean of 64 replica PCM cells programmed to 12.5 uS at t / their mean right after programming (E0.1/E0.2); a_hat = 1 at t0

conditions.all: primary: AIHWKit programming noise, drift (state-dependent exponent spread) and accumulated read noise; replica a_hat
conditions.unif: secondary: no PCM noise; uniform drift a(t) = ((t + t0)/t0)^-0.049 for every device and a_hat = a(t) (isolates transistor coupling, clipping and crosstalk)

time_note: PCM draws as E0.2: make_draws([base_seed, ds_idx, split, seed], K, 5, 64) over the five E0.2 times; E4 evaluates t0 (programming noise only, every node identical) and 1d, 30d, 1y

nodes.dac_remap: input map Ma(x) = I_0^-1(a_hat G(x) D) (lower-type nominal curve), supplies nominal
nodes.supply: V_SL(t) = V_sp,nom + D / a_hat for each branch type, input map M0
nodes.ideal: reference: G / a_hat inside the bound (mismatch-invariant global scaling), V_SL nominal, map M0

table_drift_factor: leakage tables of the dac_remap and supply regimes use a_tab(t) = ((t + t0)/t0)^-0.049 (within 0.7 % of the expected replica a_hat); the bounds themselves use the actual a_hat

datasets.synthetic: sklearn make_classification(n_samples=5000, n_features=20, n_informative=10, n_redundant=4, n_classes=4, n_clusters_per_class=2, class_sep=1.0, random_state=20261012)

model: sklearn RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=16, max_depth=6, random_state=split_seed); stratified 70/30 split with random_state=split_seed; min-max on the training split, test clipped to [0, 1]; identical to E0.1/E0.2

pools.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, rng_stream]); then, in this order, standard_normal((n, 4)) for: lower divider, lower pull-down, LBUF inverter-1 nMOS, LBUF inverter-1 pMOS, LBUF inverter-2 nMOS, LBUF inverter-2 pMOS, upper divider, upper inverter nMOS, upper inverter pMOS, upper pull-down; columns (vth0, toxe, voff, nfactor); the same draws serve P1 and P3; L6T and LBUF share the lower divider and lower pull-down draws
pools.assignment: each CAM constraint k of a forest gets the instance index rng.integers(1, n + 1) from numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed(top level), ds_idx, split, seed, 4]); lower constraints use the lower-type pool, upper constraints the UINV pool
pools.storage: divider curves stored as ln I_k - ln I_0 on a 5 mV grid inside the window [V_0(1e-10 A) - 0.1 V, V_0(5e-5 A) + 0.1 V] clipped to [0, 1.8] V (V_0 = nominal curve), float32; reconstructed on the 1 mV nominal grid

checks.C1: nominal full-branch DC (SPICE: PCM resistor, divider, inverters) equals the I-V inversion of the pool's nominal curve within 0.05 mV: every design and branch type, G in {2.5, 12.5, 22.5} uS, V_SL nominal and supply at 1 year
checks.C2: no mismatch, no PCM noise, uniform drift: supply and ideal nodes exact (<= 0.001 LSB) for every branch type; dac_remap exact for the lower type of each cell set; the upper-bound residual of the shared data line is reported (systematic, not a check)
checks.C3: load-line node voltage from the I-V surface equals the SPICE full-branch DC node voltage within 20 uV where the node lies within V_sp - 0.25 V ... V_sp + 0.05 V (L6T and UINV, G in {2.5, 12.5, 22.5} uS, V_SL nominal and supply at 1 year)
checks.C4: setup: sigma of V_sp per branch type within 15 % of the reference (L6T 22.15 mV, E1 pd_min; UINV 10.57 mV, E3b INV_S; LBUF 10.57 mV)
checks.C5: ideal 4-bit CAM equals quantized tree traversal (all datasets, split 0), as E0.1/E0.2
checks.C6: pool storage: bound voltages from the reconstructed curves equal those from the raw SPICE curves within 2 uV (all instances; currents G D for the 16 thresholds and a G D at 1 year)
checks.V1: row validation (full-row transient SPICE with the actual mismatched devices, PCM conductances and supplies): breast_cancer, split 0, seed 0, arm xt, designs P1 and P3, conditions all@t0, dac_remap@1y, supply@1y; 8 violation-matched (sample, row) pairs per design and condition with leakage sum S in [0.3, 3], evenly spread in ln S; predicted crossing t_c = t_s(N) (1 + (2N-1) w0) / S; pass if |ln(t_c,sim / t_c,pred)| <= 0.05 for >= 90 % of the 48 cases
checks.stop_rule: a failed check stops the run before any accuracy is computed (spice phase) or before any decision (forest phase)

metrics.acc_ref: accuracy of the ideal 4-bit quantized CAM (no device effects), as E0.1/E0.2
metrics.loss: 100 (acc_ref - acc) in percentage points; a sample with no matching row in any tree counts as wrong
metrics.mean_loss: mean over the 5 datasets of the per-dataset mean over 3 splits x device seeds
metrics.delta: paired difference loss(dac_remap) - loss(supply) (positive: supply better) per (dataset, split, seed); mean over datasets of the per-dataset means; SE = sqrt(sum_d var_d / n_d) / 5; 95 % CI = mean +- 1.96 SE
metrics.leaf_loss: share of (sample, tree) pairs with no matching row

hypotheses.H1: crosstalk suppressed (arm gs): the node with the smaller per-cell bound error (E2/E3b laws) gives the smaller loss: delta(P1) > 0 (supply better), delta(P3) < 0 (input remap better)
hypotheses.H2: 6T2M as published (arm xt): the supply node gives the smaller loss for both designs: delta(P1) > 0 and delta(P3) > 0
hypotheses.H3: crosstalk is first-order at the system level: crosstalk_loss at t0 (programming noise only) >= 1.0 pp for both designs
hypotheses.classification: for H1 and H2, each design: CONFIRMED if the 95 % CI excludes 0 with the predicted sign, CONTRADICTED if it excludes 0 with the opposite sign, UNRESOLVED otherwise; a confirmed difference is MATERIAL if |delta| >= 0.5 pp. H1/H2 hold if both designs are CONFIRMED. H3 holds if the mean crosstalk loss is >= 1.0 pp for both designs
hypotheses.report_only: 1 day and 30 days; arms is and gi; condition unif; per-dataset results; leaf-loss; per-cell bound-error statistics of the forests; the shared-data-line residual

smoke.note: program check only; outcomes not interpreted

not_modelled: PCM read nonlinearity (E3a) and read disturb
process corners and temperature (E2 tested the laws there)
sense-amplifier offset and noise, precharge transistor, ML wire resistance
input DAC quantization (inputs applied as continuous values, as E0.1/E0.2)
mismatch of the wildcard pull-downs (gate 0 V)
replica-cell transistor mismatch (a_hat is taken from PCM replica conductances, as E0.2)
